title: AI Defaults
description: Always-installed AI infrastructure for Demo Builder projects — MCP servers added to every generated project alongside the demo-builder entry.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers installed into the per-project isolated tools dir (<project>/.demo-builder-mcp/ — see aiDefaultsInstaller.ts). Each entry is added to .claude/mcp.json and .mcp.json next to demo-builder, with its args anchored to the isolated dir.

id.description: Stable identifier used as the key in the generated .mcp.json mcpServers map.

package.description: npm package name installed into the isolated .demo-builder-mcp tools dir.

version.description: npm semver range. Caret for >=1.0.0 packages; tilde for 0.0.x packages, where a caret is an exact pin and freezes updates.

command.description: Command Claude Code runs to start the MCP server.

args.description: Arguments passed to command. Relative paths are anchored to the isolated tools dir by mcpConfigWriter (Claude Code's launch cwd is the project root, where node_modules/... would not resolve).

description.description: Human-readable description shown in the AI Overview screen.

requires.description: Which projects this entry applies to: 'eds-storefront' = only projects with an installed EDS storefront; 'app-builder-tooling' = any project doing App Builder-adjacent work (EDS storefront, mesh, or attached App Builder component). Evaluated by aiDefaultsEntryApplies (aiToolingGate.ts).

thirdParty.description: True for tooling published outside Adobe (e.g. Playwright). Additionally gated on the demoBuilder.ai.enableThirdPartyTools setting; dependent skills are removed with the tool.
